INT. CARTOGRAPHER'S WORKSHOP - DAY

The workshop has been disturbed. Papers scattered. Cubbies emptied. In the northeast corner, a LOOSE FLOORBOARD has been pried up -- the hiding space beneath it gapes empty. The IRON CHEST is GONE.

FELIX stands in the center of the room, rigid. Sable enters behind him.

SABLE
(taking in the damage)
Felix --

The map is gone.

SABLE

This was here when you arrived?

SABLE
I just walked in. I did not leave it there.

FELIX
But someone wants it to look as though you did.

SABLE

I was not here this morning. I was at the market. All morning, from before first bell. I can prove it.

FELIX
Then we go to Holt.

"""
INT. CARTOGRAPHER'S WORKSHOP - DAY

The workshop has been disturbed. Papers scattered. Cubbies emptied. In the northeast corner, a LOOSE FLOORBOARD has been pried up -- the hiding space beneath it gapes empty. The IRON CHEST is GONE.

FELIX stands in the center of the room, rigid. Sable enters behind him.

SABLE
(taking in the damage)
Felix --

FELIX
The map is gone.

He crouches over the loose floorboard, pressing his hand into the empty space beneath.

FELIX (CONT'D)
I placed the chest under this board last night. Right here. It was here at midnight.

SABLE
Felix, I--

FELIX
(standing)
Your satchel.

Near FELIX'S DESK, on the floor, lies Sable's LEATHER SATCHEL -- EMPTY, broken clasp hanging open. Felix picks it up.

FELIX (CONT'D)
This was here when you arrived?

SABLE
I just walked in. I did not leave it there.

FELIX
But someone wants it to look as though you did.

SABLE
(shaken)
I was not here this morning. I was at the market. All morning, from before first bell. I can prove it.

FELIX
Then we go to Holt.
"""
